title: Prompt → 3D character animation (body + fingers) on any Mixamo rig, open source
author: najsonepls
selftext:
Type a motion ("makes a peace sign, then opens both hands"), and a rigged character performs it a few seconds later.

**How it works**

1. A video model (FLUX 3 Max on fal) generates a short clip of a person acting out the prompt, always from the same full-body, static-camera setup. You can also use you own webcam, real videos, or any other video model.
2. On my GPU, GVHMR recovers the 3D body motion and WiLoR tracks both hands (all 15 finger joints per hand).
3. That gets retargeted onto any Mixamo rig in the browser, and you can export a .glb for Blender/Unity.

There's also an instant MediaPipe preview while the HQ pass runs. The HQ pass is \~4–5s per 5s clip on a 4090, fingers included.

Repo: [https://github.com/blendi-remade/prompt2rig](https://github.com/blendi-remade/prompt2rig)

Happy to answer any questions!
